item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 11/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. A trough of low pressure is expected to develop over the coast of western Guangdong in the latter part of this week, and extend eastwards afterwards. Its associated heavy showers and thunderstorms will affect the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary over the weekend. With the trough of low pressure departing, showers will lessen gradually over Guangdong early next week.
